text:
maya: planning to start a phased soft-unpin of runtime 3.2.1 -> 3.3.0 tonight at 00:00 UTC (6h window). intent: lift the sticky pin for longseq perf regressions; canary at 10% then 50 -> 100. pls ack if you have any blocking workloads or hard pin needs.
aj: ack — heads up, apac-gpu-02 still running kernel 5.15 driver that showed weird cuda mem spikes on yesterday's stress. i think we should exclude that host from canary. logs: `oom: gpu0 mem spike @ 23:14`
ciara: tagging perf — we've been watching 95th latency on longseq embed tests. baseline p95 ~210ms, after test build it's ~380ms on odd samples. Not constant but spikey. :eyes:
shawn: if apac hosts are flaky we should do a regional exclusion plus an immediate throttle on batch size for canary. suggestion: canary config -> {"region_exclude": ["apac"], "batch_max_tokens": 512} and phased windows 10%->30%->100% over 6h.
maya: agreed. i'll edit the deploy config and postpone until we confirm apac kernel upgrade or exclude it. planning change: canary: eu/us only, 10%->30% in 2h increments.
deploy-bot: automated: canary config draft created by maya. command: `deploybot schedule --unpin --runtime 3.3.0 --start 2025-11-07T00:00Z --phased 6h --regions eu,us --canary 10%`
aj: quick triage note — kernel upgrade for apac is queued but wont land before midnight. apac excluded is correct. also noticed a crash pattern in dd trace: `runtime_exit: kv_cache_corrupt` - might be related to new kv cache changes in 3.3.0.
ciara: i'm running a short eval suite against a production-ish replay set, will share telemetry in ~30m. if p95 stays >300ms on replay we should abort.
shawn: +1 on abort threshold. strategy: if p95 > 300ms OR error-rate > 0.5% during any canary step, auto-abort and pin back to 3.2.1. runbook snippet: 1) `deploybot abort --id <run_id>` 2) `deploybot pin --runtime 3.2.1 --sticky` 3) route fallback to smaller model variant for affected customers.
maya: sounds good. @ops-bot can you pre-create the pinback job so we don't scramble?
ops-bot: automated: pinback job pre-created: `job-317000-pback`. will notify on status.
deploy-bot: automated: scheduled canary created (id run-317000): regions=eu,us, canary=10%, throttle=512 tokens, start=2025-11-07T00:00Z. will post updates at each step.
ciara: telemetry update: replay p50 42ms -> 44ms, p95 215ms -> 365ms on the canary binary when run against the longseq set. also saw a 0.6% error spike for batch sizes >256.
aj: that crosses our threshold (error-rate > 0.5%). we should abort before the canary.
maya: aborting schedule now. calling abort and pinback.
deploy-bot: automated: run-317000: ABORT requested by maya. initiating abort sequence.
ops-bot: automated: executing pinback job job-317000-pback -> `deploybot pin --runtime 3.2.1 --sticky`
ops-bot: automated: pin applied to runtime:3.2.1, reason: canary telemetry breach (error-rate 0.6%, p95>300ms).
shawn: copying runbook for rollback notes: 1) note reason in release notes draft 2) open follow-up ticket to investigate kv_cache corruption pattern 3) plan smaller canary with kv-cache diag flags enabled 4) schedule kernel upgrades for apac hosts
ciara: i'll attach the replay and traces to ticket ENG-5427. also adding a small prompt set for regression tests.
maya: good catch everyone, thanks. i'll update the release notes: "soft-unpin for runtime 3.3.0 aborted due to elevated p95 and error-rate on longseq; pinned back to 3.2.1. follow-ups: ENG-5427 (kv cache), infra-ops kernel upgrade apac."
aj: feel free to ping me if you want me to run extended repros on the apac stack after kernel bump.
maya: closing thread — will reopen if ops-bot reports any pinback errors. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: automated: job-317000-pback completed successfully at 3170008620.
